# nb-studio project

## project create

Create a project

Needs `create` on `pm.projects`. The caller becomes a member and, unless `leadUserId` says otherwise, its lead.

```bash
nb-studio project create <name>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `name`   |             |

| Flag            | Type        | Description                    |
| --------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------ |
| `--description` | string      | (or --description-file <path>) |
| `--visibility`  | everyone \\ | members                        |           |
| `--status`      | planned \\  | in_progress \\                 | paused \\ | completed \\ | cancelled |     |
| `--priority`    | urgent \\   | high \\                        | medium \\ | low \\       | none      |     |
| `--lead`        | string      |                                |
| `--start-date`  | string      |                                |
| `--due-date`    | string      |                                |
| `--workflow`    | string      |                                |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `pm.projects/create`.

**Request:** `POST /api/projects` (`projectsCreateProject`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio project create "Mobile app" --lead <user>
```

## project delete

Delete a project

Needs `delete` on `pm.projects`. Its issues are kept, without a project.

```bash
nb-studio project delete <project>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `project` |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                                            |
| ------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this project? Its issues are kept, without a project.” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `pm.projects/delete`.

**Request:** `DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}` (`projectsDeleteProject`)

## project invitation create

Invite people

Needs `invite` on the `pm.members` settings item, or leading a project: a lead invites only into projects they lead and manages only their own invitations. An address that already has an account is added to the projects at once; every other address is sent a link. One result per address.

```bash
nb-studio project invitation create --email <string[]>
```

| Flag        | Type     | Description            |
| ----------- | -------- | ---------------------- |
| `--email`   | string[] | (required; repeatable) |
| `--project` | string[] | (repeatable)           |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/invitations` (`projectsCreateInvitations`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio project invitation create --email ada@example.com --project <project>
```

## project location add

Add a working directory to a project

For whoever manages the project. Adds a working directory as the New project wizard does (a new repository, an existing one or a directory on a runner), with its own "Initialize" issue when a prompt or a template’s workflow initializes it, and, for a repository, its "Deploy & previews" choices. Everything is checked before anything is made: a new repository is created only then.

```bash
nb-studio project location add <project>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `project` |             |

| Flag                 | Type       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| -------------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--code-location`    | newRepo \\ | existingRepo \\                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | runnerDirectory |     |
| `--init-agent`       | string     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--new-repo`         | json       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--existing-repo`    | json       | Picked through a connection (`connectionId`, `repoId`, `fullName`), or given by its clone URL alone.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--runner-directory` | json       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--label`            | string     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--deploy`           | json       | A repository’s "Deploy & previews" choices: the Apps they need are created and linked once it is added.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `--ci`               | json       | A "Configure CI" run carried out once the repository is added: a new repository’s workflows are committed once it is initialized, an existing one’s proposed in a pull request, an agent’s issue created (`POST /api/repositoryDeployments/{resourceId}/ci/configure`). |
| `--file`             | path       | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/{projectId}/codeLocations` (`projectSetupsAddCodeLocation`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio project location add <project> --file location.json
```

## project resource add

Add a working directory to a project

Needs `manage` on the project: its lead, or a wider scope. A `gitRepo` needs `url`; a `directory` needs `runnerId` and an absolute `path`.

```bash
nb-studio project resource add <project> --type <string>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `project` |             |

| Flag            | Type       | Description                    |
| --------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------ |
| `--type`        | gitRepo \\ | directory                      | (required) |
| `--url`         | string     |                                |
| `--default-ref` | string     |                                |
| `--binding`     | json       |                                |
| `--runner`      | string     |                                |
| `--path`        | string     |                                |
| `--label`       | string     |                                |
| `--init-prompt` | string     | (or --init-prompt-file <path>) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/{projectId}/resources` (`projectsCreateProjectResource`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio project resource add <project> --type gitRepo --url https://github.com/acme/app.git
nb-studio project resource add <project> --type directory --runner <runner> --path /srv/app
```

## project setup create

Create a project with its working directory

For whoever may create projects. Creates the project with its workflow and working directory (a new repository, an existing one, a directory on a runner, or none), and the "Initialize project" issue when the directory is initialized. Everything is checked before anything is made; linking a repository asks for its own permission.

```bash
nb-studio project setup create
```

| Flag                 | Type       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| -------------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--name`             | string     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--description`      | string     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--workflow`         | string     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--code-location`    | newRepo \\ | existingRepo \\                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | runnerDirectory \\ | none |     |
| `--init-agent`       | string     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--new-repo`         | json       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--existing-repo`    | json       | Picked through a connection (`connectionId`, `repoId`, `fullName`), or given by its clone URL alone.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--runner-directory` | json       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--label`            | string     |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--deploy`           | json       | A repository’s "Deploy & previews" choices: the Apps they need are created and linked once it is added.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `--ci`               | json       | A "Configure CI" run carried out once the repository is added: a new repository’s workflows are committed once it is initialized, an existing one’s proposed in a pull request, an agent’s issue created (`POST /api/repositoryDeployments/{resourceId}/ci/configure`). |
| `--file`             | path       | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projectSetups` (`projectSetupsCreateProject`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio project setup create --name Web --code-location none
nb-studio project setup create --file project.json
```

## project update

Update a project

Needs `manage` on the project: its lead, or a wider scope. Switching `workflowId` is refused while an issue is in a status the new workflow lacks (400 `WORKFLOW_STATUS_CONFLICT`).

```bash
nb-studio project update <project>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `project` |             |

| Flag            | Type        | Description                    |
| --------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------ |
| `--name`        | string      |                                |
| `--description` | string      | (or --description-file <path>) |
| `--visibility`  | everyone \\ | members                        |           |
| `--status`      | planned \\  | in_progress \\                 | paused \\ | completed \\ | cancelled |     |
| `--priority`    | urgent \\   | high \\                        | medium \\ | low \\       | none      |     |
| `--lead`        | string      |                                |
| `--start-date`  | string      |                                |
| `--due-date`    | string      |                                |
| `--workflow`    | string      |                                |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.projects/manage`.

**Request:** `PATCH /api/projects/{projectId}` (`projectsUpdateProject`)
